title: Pokemon TCG Drampa 138/162 Holo Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Drampa card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector. With its stunning Holo Rare design and powerful abilities, it's sure to be a valuable addition to your collection. Featuring the popular character Drampa, this card is a true gem for fans of the game. 

The card is numbered 138/162 and is in excellent shape, with no noticeable flaws. Whether you're a seasoned collector or just starting out, this card is a great choice for anyone looking to add some excitement to their Pokémon TCG collection.
